'''CL-33/890''', or simply '''Nine-Oh''', was a [[Clone Lieutenant/Legends|clone trooper 2nd Lieutenant]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He worked with [[Four-One]], [[Seven-Four]], and [[Eight-Three]] on a [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i]] [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]] during the [[Battle of Haruun Kal/Legends|Battle of Haruun Kal]], operating the navigation system. His gunship was assigned to the medium cruiser ''[[Halleck]]''.<ref name="Equipment (short story)" />

His gunship sustained heavy damage during the space battle at Haruun Kal, though the ship endured and assisted with the post-battle rescue of stranded [[Clone trooper/Legends|clones]].<ref name="Equipment (short story)" />
